title: HDF Result Primitives
description: Types for representing assessment results and statuses.

Result_Status.description: The status of an individual test result. 'not_applicable' indicates the requirement does not apply to the target. 'not_reviewed' indicates the requirement was not assessed (e.g., requires manual verification). 'skipped' is deprecated; use 'not_applicable' (impact=0) or 'not_reviewed' (impact>0) instead.
Result_Status.title: Result Status

Overall_Status.description: The final status of a requirement after all post-processing (attestations, waivers) is applied.
Overall_Status.title: Overall Status

status.description: The status of this test within the requirement. Example: 'failed'.

code_desc.description: A description of this test. Example: 'limits.conf * is expected to include ["hard", "maxlogins", "10"]'.

run_time.description: The execution time in seconds for the test.

start_time.description: The time at which the test started.

resource.description: The resource used in the test. Example: 'file', 'command', 'service'.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource. Example: '/etc/passwd'.

message.description: An explanation of the test status - usually only provided when the test fails.

skip_message.description: An explanation of why the test was not reviewed or not applicable.

exception.description: The type of exception if an exception was thrown.

backtrace.description: The stacktrace/backtrace of the exception if one occurred.

Requirement_Result.description: A test within a requirement and its results and findings such as how long it took to run.
Requirement_Result.title: Requirement Result

Requirement_Description.description: A labeled description for a requirement, such as fix text or check instructions.
Requirement_Description.title: Requirement Description
